label: Midday Update
headline: S&P -2.7% at 11:34, VIX 33.9, 10y 4.81% -10bp, core PCE 3.3% vs 3.2% expected
stance: Tech selling deepened after the open and pulled gold lower too. Treasuries rallied 10bp even with core PCE above forecast.

scorecard.call: Nasdaq futures lower on tariff reports
scorecard.actual: Right. Nasdaq -4% at 11:19am ET. The US proposed tariffs on 14 trading partners at 11:02am ET.

scorecard.call: Treasury yields lower ahead of PCE and GDP
scorecard.actual: Right, and further. 10y 4.81% at 11:19am ET, -10bp, despite core PCE above forecast.

scorecard.call: Crude fell in early Asian trade
scorecard.actual: Reversed. Brent $93.30 at 11:24am ET, +2.1%, after Saudi Arabia shot down drones over Ras Tanura.

bullets: Core PCE +3.3% y/y in October vs 3.2% expected. Headline 3.8%, as expected (8:30am ET).
Q3 GDP revised to 4.3% vs 3.5% expected. Initial claims 189K vs 201K expected (8:30am ET).
Firm growth and sticky inflation support a hike at the FOMC, Dec 9. The 10y fell anyway.
Chipmakers led stocks lower after the open (~10:33am ET).
Gold $3,441, -3.2% (~10:47am ET), lower with stocks despite the drop in yields.

items.head: Nvidia gives back over half of Monday's rally
items.body: Led chip stocks lower after the open (~10:43am ET).

watch.head: Thanksgiving, Thursday
watch.body: US stock and bond markets closed. Friday's session ends early.
